mapper.insert: INSERT INTO family_groups (name, status, invite_code, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{status}, #{inviteCode}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE family_groups SET name = #{name}, status = #{status}, invite_code = #{inviteCode} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, status, invite_code, created_at FROM family_groups WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, status, invite_code, created_at FROM family_groups WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode}

SELECT g.id FROM family_groups g WHERE g.created_at < #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM family_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.family_group_id = g.id AND u.line_user_id NOT LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')) ORDER BY g.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM family_groups WHERE id IN #{id}
